title: Preserve original text
guidance: Keep exact bytes, names, numbers, code, IDs and quotations; proposed edits require explicit permission.
scope: 引用・名前・コード・識別子を扱う。

title: Quotation conventions
guidance: Record en-US/en-GB and publisher style before suggesting quotation punctuation; preserve quotations and intentional variants.
scope: 引用符の扱いが、選んだ編集規約と一致しない。

title: Ambiguous dates
guidance: Flag numeric dates such as 03/04/2026 for locale/house-style confirmation; never silently swap month and day.
scope: 日・月が数値だけで表記され、地域が不明である。

title: Figure features
guidance: Compare tabular versus proportional figures and lining versus oldstyle in actual tables, amounts and running text; retain numeric values.
scope: 本文・数値比較・価格表示の数字を設定する。

title: Optical size
guidance: Use an available opsz axis for the actual size and renderer, then inspect; no universal font-size multiplier.
scope: 選択したフォントがopsz軸を持つ。

title: Confusable identifiers
guidance: Inspect Il1, O0, rn/m and 8B in actual code/ID fonts; do not replace characters to resolve visual ambiguity.
scope: ID、コード、数字主体のUIに書体を使用する。

title: Glyph coverage
guidance: Inspect required accents, currencies and mixed scripts in the selected fallback chain and actual output.
scope: 必要な文字が選択したフォントに含まれていない。

title: Intentional fragments
guidance: Treat brand phrases and display fragments as potentially deliberate. Confirm purpose before grammar or capitalization proposals.
scope: 見出し、ボタン、広告に完全文ではない表現がある。

title: Compressed noun phrases
guidance: Review audience understanding of noun stacks; offer separately labeled alternatives only within editing permission.
scope: 国際向けの説明・操作に、圧縮された名詞列がある。

title: Paragraph topic
guidance: Check the paragraph topic and reading sequence against purpose; semantic judgment remains human review.
scope: 情報説明の長文を扱う。

title: Terminology
guidance: Compare abbreviations and terms with the supplied house style; retain proper names, code and approved exceptions.
scope: 同じ概念に複数の名称が使われている。

title: Readability claims
guidance: Separate measured evidence from readability hypotheses; no universal performance or aesthetic score.
scope: 書体を推薦する。

title: Typeface classification
guidance: Use classification as a comparison aid, not proof of suitability; compare actual glyphs and output.
scope: 多言語の書体を検索・分類する。

title: Language and script
guidance: Separate language, script, locale and direction; Latn does not establish English.

conditions: 複数の言語や文字体系を含む原稿、UI、テンプレートを取り込む場合
数値・日時などlocale依存の内容がある場合

title: Explicit language wins
guidance: Use explicit language before documentLang; do not overwrite either from script clues.

conditions: コンテンツ、利用者、翻訳資源に明示言語がある場合
自動言語推定が併用される場合

title: Ambiguous Latin text
guidance: Short brands, code and shared Latin vocabulary remain uncertain without explicit language context.

conditions: Latinの短文、固有名、ブランド名、製品コード、URLを判定する場合

title: Base and inserted language
guidance: Record base-language policy and inserted spans; preserve Japanese, Chinese and Korean punctuation and words.

conditions: 一つの文章内に別言語の語や製品名が挿入される場合
和欧文・中西文・韓英の文中混植を扱う場合

title: Visual spacing
guidance: Change layout separately from source characters; do not insert spaces or NBSP into immutable text.

conditions: 文字体系の境界に見かけの空きを設ける場合
文面を保護する商品名、検索語、URL、コードを扱う場合

title: Script-specific tracking
guidance: Avoid inheriting Latin letter spacing into Arabic joining or other scripts; inspect each script in context.

conditions: Latin用trackingやletter-spacingが他の文字体系へ継承される場合
接続・結合・補助記号を含む見出しやUIを扱う場合

title: Regional CJK glyphs
guidance: Retain ja, zh-Hans and zh-Hant language tags; inspect region-specific glyphs and fallback.

conditions: Han文字を含むja、zh-Hans、zh-Hant-TW等の内容を表示する場合
複数のCJKフォントから字形を選択する場合

title: Mixed-script scale
guidance: Compare visual weight, baseline and x-height for actual fonts; do not impose a fixed cross-script ratio.

conditions: 異なる文字体系のサイズ、weight、ベースラインを調整する場合
既存ブランドの倍率を別書体へ転用しようとする場合

title: Fallback and line height
guidance: Test fallback glyphs, ascenders, descenders and line boxes after loading and on failure.

conditions: フォント読込失敗、未収録文字、OSフォントによる代替が起こり得る場合

title: Bidirectional isolation
guidance: For dynamic inserts use semantic bdi or dir=auto as appropriate, retain logical source order and test copy/paste.

conditions: LTR文中にRTLの氏名等を挿入する場合
RTL文中に英語の型番、数字、記号等を挿入する場合

title: Logical RTL order
guidance: Never reverse stored characters for visual RTL layout; preserve code, numbers and punctuation.

conditions: RTLまたは双方向文字列を保存・変換・出力する場合

title: Joining controls
guidance: Preserve ZWJ/ZWNJ and Arabic/Persian joining controls; actual shaping requires the target engine.

conditions: ArabicやPersianの接続制御を含む原稿を処理する場合
不可視文字を削除または正規化する機能を適用する場合

title: Grapheme integrity
guidance: Preserve combining marks and emoji/Indic sequences; never split a grapheme for tracking or line wrapping.

conditions: 選択、省略、文字数制限、文字単位アニメーション、改行を行う場合
結合文字、分解Jamo、Indic、emoji等を含む場合

title: Script-specific wrapping
guidance: Use language-aware word and line breaks; distinguish Latin words, CJK line breaking, Korean profiles and Thai segmentation.

conditions: 多言語の改行、均等割付、狭幅レイアウトを設定する場合

title: Clipping risk
guidance: Inspect marks and descenders at narrow widths and text enlargement; avoid untested fixed-height or hidden text.

conditions: 固定高、overflow、狭いline-heightを使う要素がある場合
Vietnamese等の上下記号や結合を含む場合

title: Language-specific emphasis
guidance: Choose emphasis with the language owner; Latin uppercase is not a universal emphasis mechanism.

conditions: italic、bold、大文字化等の強調を翻訳や別文字体系へ展開する場合

title: Locale-sensitive values
guidance: Format proposed display values only with explicit locale and house style; preserve original date, currency and number source.

conditions: 数値、通貨、日付、時刻、単位等を表示する場合

title: Translation expansion
guidance: Allow labels and controls to grow; test long words and actual translated text, retaining action and recovery meaning.

conditions: UIラベル、カード、ボタン等を翻訳する場合
原文と訳文で長さや行数が変化する場合

title: Language hierarchy
guidance: Make primary and equal-status languages explicit in hierarchy and reading order; avoid accidental suppression.

conditions: 二言語以上の案内、見出し、対訳、ブランドを設計する場合

title: Original names
guidance: Keep names in original spelling and ordering; transliteration and renaming require permission.

conditions: 氏名、表示名、個人の原綴りを入力・保存・表示する場合

title: CSS support
guidance: Check target browser support before adopting new text-spacing or wrapping features; retain usable fallback.

conditions: text-autospace、font-size-adjust等のCSS機能を採用する場合
草案や実装差のある機能に依存する場合

title: Graphic text
guidance: Separate editable text, visual outlines and reading-order alternatives; do not rewrite source to mimic a graphic.

conditions: 二言語ロゴ、ポスター見出し、カスタム字形等を編集する場合

title: Normalization
guidance: NFC equivalence is diagnostic only; preserve original Unicode, metadata and normalization unless authorized.

conditions: Unicode正規化、幅変換、不可視文字の整理等を実行する場合
氏名、引用、価格、単位、識別子を含む保護原稿を処理する場合

title: Measurement provenance
guidance: Label published values, static checks, rendered measurements and human judgments separately.

conditions: 倍率、サイズ、行高、可読性等の根拠を登録する場合
公開デザイン事例や実測データをルール化する場合

title: Visual hierarchy
guidance: Choose roles for body, heading, UI and display copy from audience, medium and distance; no universal type scale.
scope: 見出し・本文・補足が同居する画面や紙面

title: Long words and IDs
guidance: Use bounded wrapping for long URLs/IDs without breaking ordinary English words indiscriminately; test extraction.
scope: 通常英語とURL・コードが同居する出力

title: User spacing
guidance: Test user line/word/letter spacing changes without lost text or clipped controls.
scope: WCAG 1.4.12が適用されるWebのテキスト

title: Narrow reflow
guidance: At 320 CSS px check content, actions, order and overlap; report exceptions with evidence.
scope: WCAG 1.4.10の対象となるWebコンテンツ

title: Text enlargement
guidance: Test 200% text resize in the actual browser; source presence is not a rendered pass.
scope: WCAG 1.4.4の適用対象

title: Font loading
guidance: Test loading and blocked-font fallback, layout shift, licensing and offline behavior in the real target.
scope: Web fontを利用する出力

title: Contrast
guidance: Measure actual foreground/background colors and states; visual impression alone does not prove contrast.
scope: WCAG 1.4.3の適用対象

title: Final output
guidance: Reopen Office/PDF and inspect font embedding, extraction, reading order and visual output; unrun checks stay not-checked.
scope: PDF、Office、HTML等を納品またはレビューするとき

title: Regional spelling is a proposal
guidance: Preserve names such as World Health Organization, AirAsia, trademarks, quotations, code, IDs and approved exceptions. Regional spelling candidates require explicit editing permission; never apply global suffix replacement.

conditions: Explicit English locale and applicable editorial context supplied

title: House style has a bounded scope
guidance: Select an explicit organization, publication and applicable medium before offering changes. University of Oxford -ise and OUP Music & Letters -ize are distinct; en-GB alone selects neither. Microsoft sentence case and SGDS UI contractions guidance are not country-wide rules.

conditions: Explicit English locale and applicable editorial context supplied

title: Context-dependent regional vocabulary
guidance: Ask about meeting intent before interpreting table; prepone, CR/comfort room, robot, grand and takeaway may be valid regional or contextual usage. Mark needs-review; do not diagnose an error or replace meaning from locale alone.

conditions: Explicit English locale and applicable editorial context supplied

title: Canadian spelling combinations
guidance: Retain Canadian combinations such as centre with organize and program. Choose the supplied Canadian house style; do not normalize all words to a British or US dictionary.

conditions: Explicit English locale and applicable editorial context supplied

title: Tone and grammar require intent
guidance: Regional usage and register are contextual. Preserve deliberate fragments, brand voice and regional grammar; offer audience-scoped alternatives only with permission, never a universal correctness score.

conditions: Explicit English locale and applicable editorial context supplied

title: Regional names and display values
guidance: Preserve te reo Māori macrons, names, mixed scripts, date meaning, numeric values, currency codes and time zones. Ambiguous dates stay needs-review; locale formatting is not currency conversion or permission to normalize Unicode.

conditions: Explicit English locale and applicable editorial context supplied
